data.title: 八重神子 · 神樱月下的宫司花嫁
data.description: 【鸣神大社神樱参道·黄昏】八重神子穿着红白相间的花嫁和装，粉色长发沿着头纱落下，手中捧花像一册新书；她回眸时笑意从编辑部的戏谑变成神明才有的从容温柔。
data.action: 神樱参道捧书卷般的花束回眸，戏谑笑意变成从容温柔
data.lighting: pink twilight under lanterns and falling petals
data.promptProse: Yae Miko turns gently beneath the Sacred Sakura, holding a bouquet arranged like a freshly opened volume against her red-and-white shrine bridal kimono. Gold cords and a translucent veil frame pink hair and fox ears. The vertical medium-full composition shows the approach narrowing behind her among falling petals. Lantern light picks out the bouquet and veil folds, while pink twilight softly colors her unhurried smile and the distant branches.
